'''The Ancient One''' was the name of a giant [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slug]] [[Queen/Legends|queen]] living on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] until [[3642 BBY]], when it was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces during the [[invasion of Taris]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Ancient One appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Heroic World Boss on the Imperial version of Taris. It is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means it was killed.
